module_name: Persistent Source Registry and Signal Intake Runtime
objective: Persist and replay controlled source registry activity, ingestion runs, observations, signal inbox items, health checks and audit events without activating live connectors.
migration_renumbering_note: Renumbered from protected-main 008 during AGENT-021 convergence because 008_neuroscience_abstraction_layer.sql already owns migration 008; schema semantics are unchanged.
go_rules: manual-only sources cannot use automated access methods
observations require evidence refs and snapshot/hash provenance
observations are deduplicated by source_id plus extract_hash_or_snapshot_id
signals preserve evidence refs, confidence and downstream use cases
snapshots replay sources, runs, observations, signals, health checks and events
hold_rules: no BUILD-READY claim for production persistence
